issuesFoundAndFixed: Initial 21 automation acceptance cases all failed against behavior-throwing stubs/old MR before implementation, then passed with the existing suite.

User confirmed custrecord_ppa_method incorrectly referenced Transaction. After the UI correction, a read-only query returned 60 allocation rows, 207 allocated, zero refunded, all unverified for customer 5240.

Two new cash-refund tests reproduced the exact gross-cash rejection before implementation. A full pure-pallet posted cash credit now uses the credited quantity while retaining net cash principal and explicit historical-tax return reference.

Adversarial tests found that native xedit omissions can be empty strings and that a manual externalid-only xedit can omit its allocation link. Both were observed failing before getFields-based loading and link lookup corrections.
An adversarial test found a missing customer on a referenced allocation was silent; it now logs a capture failure.

The first gauntlet passed types/lint/79 acceptance tests/coverage/properties but stopped on a stale mutation anchor after a variable rename. The anchor was corrected and the entire gauntlet rerun; all 20 mutations were detected.
Additional checks of already implemented bounds, writer guards and generated-record exclusion are backed by corresponding detected mutations; original business assertions were not weakened.

User reported PALLET INPUT FAILED at 5:13 PM after clearing 5240. Two new cases reproduced SSS_SEARCH_ERROR_OCCURRED at the old customers() paged fetch before implementation. Replaced the UNION query with separate native N/search customer groups; all 81 acceptance cases, 4800 generated cases and 23 mutations passed in the final fresh run.

nativeEvidence.fieldCorrection: User changed custrecord_ppa_method List/Record from Transaction to Payment Method; no assistant schema mutation.

limitsAndSkippedLayers: Native NetSuite N/record, N/search and N/task are tested through boundary fixtures. Successful upload and role/context behavior of new deployments still require account validation.

A lost event before queue persistence (e.g. missing permissions), disabled triggers, or a transaction written by another User Event requires source integration to call the queue helper or a backfill. The dispatcher recovers durable queued work; it cannot reconstruct uncaptured events.
Balances update after background processing; no synchronous freshness guarantee or concurrent refund authorization lock is provided.
Missing card last4, partial/mixed settlements, on-account provenance and insufficient original method capacity remain REVIEW. Customer 5240 is not claimed fully reconciled.
Branch coverage is 86.31%, not exhaustive proof. Historical cash change is deliberately limited to one fully posted refund of a pure pallet credit without manual/on-account allocation.
Original large-customer/governance and unsupported-tax checks remain; no truncation of history to force verification.
Repository-wide application tests skipped because these scripts are not imported by the live application and no application code changed.
Random individual-test order is not supported by this runner; reversed file order passed. No commit/checkpoint cadence requested; source identified by SHA256.

Pinned disposable development tools emitted ESLint 9 and transitive glob deprecation warnings; audit including dev dependencies returned zero vulnerabilities. No tool dependencies are shipped or installed in the application.
